subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds 3- and 4-letter words using single letters and digraphs taught this term; spells 10 words a week

show.line: Let's build a word! c-a-t. Push the sounds together. Cat! Now a longer one. f-r-o-g. Frog!

rounds.prompt: Listen. m-a-p. Push the sounds together. What word is it?
Listen. s-u-n. Which picture is it?
Listen. s-t-e-p. Four sounds. What word is it?
Which letter tile is missing? h-gap-t. Hat.
Shop. Which tiles build the word shop?
Listen. s-i-t. What word is it?

hints: Say each sound, then say them faster and faster until they join.
Look at the first sound and the last sound. What word fits?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will build the word pin.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: p-i-n. Pin! Look, I built it.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I used e, not i. My tiles say pen.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's build it together. p-i-n. Pin!

parent_line: Can build and read three- and four-letter words from their sounds.
